judged_text: In sharing mode zohoCrmTokenInfo is a fetch Response but the code reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` expecting the axios response shape, and Response.data is undefined, so the property access throws TypeError. Every Zoho CRM token refresh in sharing mode crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)', failing the calendar operation instead of refreshing the token.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the token refresh call is wrapped with `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. That helper returns a `fetch()` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` are truthy (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). Immediately after, the code still treats the result as an Axios response (`zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`). A `Response` has no `.data`, so in sharing mode `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and accessing `.error` will throw, breaking Zoho CRM token refresh.
